metadata.description: Design the meeting before, close it after, audit the ones that repeat

plugins.name: meeting-design
plugins.description: Three skills for the whole life of a meeting. meeting-design fixes a pasted invite or builds an agenda: a verdict, a rewritten invite, the attendee cut and the meeting cost. meeting-close turns pasted notes into a decision record, a follow-up message and a list of what was never decided. meeting-audit takes recurring meetings and says which to keep, shrink, make async or kill, with hours freed and a sunset date. Works from pasted text; no recording, no connector required.
